title: bromus hordeaceus var. pacensis
intro: Bromus hordeaceus var. pacensis, commonly known as Pacific Brome, is a perennial grass species native to the western coast of North America. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pacific Brome include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, promoting the removal of excess fluids from the body. Bioactive constituents of Pacific Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
